Ladner real estate market stats for September 2026: benchmark prices and trends

faq.a: Delta's Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400, 2024 ("Housing Our Future," adopted July 8, 2024) — a single consolidated plan with no area-plan schedules; the Ladner Area Plan was Schedule B.3 of the previous OCP, Bylaw No. 3950, 1985.

faq.q: When are Delta property taxes due?
faq.a: July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on outstanding balances after July 2, 2026 and a further 5% after September 2, 2026.

faq.q: What bus connects Ladner to the Canada Line?
faq.a: TransLink route 601 runs via Ladner Exchange to Bridgeport Station on the Canada Line; routes 609 (to South Delta Exchange) and 618 (Ladner North loop) also serve Ladner Exchange.
